Lucas Manker.title: Research and Development Manager
Lucas Manker.quote: In my time working with Jenna, she has consistently stood out in three areas: she was completely dependable, she was able to work independently with very little oversight, and the quality of her work was excellent.
originalData: I am writing to recommend Jenna Cioffi. I was her manager at Horrocks Engineers for two years, where she worked as a Software Engineer. Her position was eliminated as part of a reduction in force and was not related to her performance.

In my time working with Jenna, she has consistently stood out in three areas: she was completely dependable, she was able to work independently with very little oversight, and the quality of her work was excellent.
Dependable: Whenever we faced a critical issue that needed to be fixed, Jenna was always reachable and stuck with it until the problem was resolved.
Independent: Jenna is extremely organized and is very skilled at independently finding solutions to problems. She's very good at managing her time and meeting deadlines without intervention.

High-quality work: Jenna was the sole front-end developer for an in-house application currently used by our firm and other sister firms in our organization. Her code was clean, organized, and very well documented. This application is a big part of many users' jobs, and Jenna's high-quality work has made their jobs much easier.
Beyond her technical skills, Jenna is great at communication and works well with others. I strongly recommend Jenna, and I am happy to discuss her work further.

Courtney Bovee Winans.title: Public Engagement Practice Lead
Courtney Bovee Winans.quote: Jenna played a key role in the development of HIVE, Horrocks’ public engagement GIS stakeholder database application. HIVE is designed to help project teams connect with communities, communicate project information, and gather meaningful public input.
originalData: I am pleased to recommend Jenna Cioffi. I had the opportunity to work with Jenna while she was on our GIS team at Horrocks, where she distinguished herself as a great communicator and technical capabilities to think outside of the box.

Jenna played a key role in the development of HIVE, Horrocks’ public engagement GIS stakeholder database application. HIVE is designed to help project teams connect with communities, communicate project information, and gather meaningful public input. Jenna’s contributions helped advance the application and improve how our teams use technology to support effective public engagement.

She worked closely with me and my team to develop frameworks, discuss feedback and adapt to they this new application could improve our workflow efficiency. She was thoughtful in her communication, receptive to feedback, and effective at understanding the needs of both project teams and end users.

Jenna was also someone we could rely on to follow through and deliver. She approached her work with professionalism, took ownership of her responsibilities, and remained focused on producing solutions that were practical and valuable to the team.
I am confident Jenna would be a great asset to any organization fortunate enough to have her and I am happy to recommend her without hesitation.

Becky Hjelm.title: Digital Transformation Manager
Becky Hjelm.quote: During that time, I have found Jenna to be passionate, thoughtful, and committed to delivering high-quality work. She demonstrates strong attention to detail and consistently focuses on client satisfaction.
originalData: My name is Becky Hjelm, and I serve as the Digital Transformation Manager at Horrocks. I am pleased to provide this reference for Jenna Cioffi, who has served as a developer on our Research and Development team for nearly two years. Over the past eight months, since the Research and Development team began reporting through me, I have had the opportunity to work with Jenna and become familiar with the quality of her contributions.

During that time, I have found Jenna to be passionate, thoughtful, and committed to delivering high-quality work. She demonstrates strong attention to detail and consistently focuses on client satisfaction. Jenna also has a clear interest in continuous improvement, which has been evident in her work on Project Hive. In that role, she has proactively developed solutions, supported quality control efforts, and helped ensure the final product meets a high standard.
Jenna’s initiative, attention to detail, and commitment to quality would make her a valuable addition to any development team. I am pleased to recommend her.
